notes.11: This question proved challenging. The most successful candidates worked out the missing angles in the triangles; however, even when this was done the answer DF was still often selected as this was 90 degrees for the angle DFE . This suggests a misconception that the 90 degree angle was formed by the diameter and a chord, rather than it being subtended at the circumference of the circle by the diameter.

notes.21: The most common error in this question was not realising that there were different units of centimetres and millimetres.
